boundary_derivation: Use the organizer's canonical equal chronological six-slice derivation over the complete visible-development evaluation index. Team-05 supplies no hand-dated boundaries.
required_partition_properties: six folds in strict chronological order
slice sizes equal under the organizer rule
expanding past-only replay state with no test observation entering prior state
construction: After the evaluator materializes exact boundaries, create one independently hash-bound model declaration per fold. The model is a frozen deterministic rule with no learned coefficients, but every replay remains past-only and distinct.
label_policy: The strategy has no training label. The prospective A5 diagnostic label is evaluation-only and cannot enter fold state, selection, or targets.
stitching_rule: Stitch organizer-derived test returns once in fold order; include no training return and permit no gap, overlap, local boundary substitution, or hand-dated fallback.
admissibility_condition: Exact evaluator-derived boundaries, per-fold model/target hashes, and the stitched-return hash are materialized and organizer-bound before metrics are recorded.
